# jun01t Portfolio

> Software engineer portfolio by jun01t. Static Nuxt site hosted on AWS (S3 + CloudFront), with a SES contact API and Cloudflare Turnstile spam protection.

The preferred site URL is https://jun01t-portfolio.jun01t.com/

## Site

- [Home](https://jun01t-portfolio.jun01t.com/): Portfolio landing page with projects, skills, and contact form
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jun01t/jun01t-portfolio): Source code and infrastructure (Terraform)

## Projects

- [jun01t Portfolio](https://jun01t-portfolio.jun01t.com/): This site
- [CSV Viewer](https://github.com/jun01t/csv-viewer): CSV viewing tool
- [Weather Outfit Suggestor](https://github.com/jun01t/weather-outfit-suggestor): Weather-based outfit suggestions
- [Leap Year Site](https://github.com/jun01t/leap-year-site): Leap year utility site
- [Konkatsu Diagnosis](https://github.com/jun01t/konkatsu-diagnosis): AI marriage-market diagnosis demo
- [favicon-getter](https://favicon-getter.vercel.app): Favicon fetch CLI / API / Web UI
- [Simple MBTI](https://simple-mbti-self.vercel.app/): 4-question MBTI personality quiz
